findings.problem: POST /api/v1/fin/fiscal-years/search is still cited by verb and path, because P3.1's registry assigns it no contract id. It is the only served endpoint the frontend uses that is not numbered.
findings.fix: P3.1 numbers the endpoint in its next delta. The single path citation in the frontend plan and registry-exec-fe is then replaced by that id (ADR-FIN-061 mechanism).

findings.artifact: srs-fin.md AC-FIN-019 / AC-FIN-021 vs published API-FIN-019 error body
findings.problem: The 'names the offending line (and dimension)' half of AC-FIN-019 and AC-FIN-021 cannot be met: fieldErrors[].field carries only the catalogue code. This is tracked (ADR-FIN-065 §9, ADR-FIN-066). The frontend binds the refusal to the lines-pane slot and the test plans mark this half as expected to fail.
findings.fix: P3.1's next delta publishes the offending lineNo (and dimensionId for FIN-409-INVALID-DIMENSION) in fieldErrors[] of API-FIN-019. TC-FIN-019 and TC-FIN-021 then pass as written, and TC-FIN-067 and TC-FIN-069 bind the message to its line.

findings.artifact: backend-execution-plan-fin.md (API-FIN-005, 009, 012, 015; fiscal-year search) ↔ frontend-execution-plan-fin.md RECORD-QUERY hooks
findings.problem: The five RECORD-QUERY hooks filter on dimensionPk, eventTypeRulePk, recurringTemplatePk, allocationRulePk and fiscalYearPk EQUALS. The backend plan's Request lines for those searches list only business filters (code, eventTypeCode, names, isActiveFl, …). The frontend therefore depends on a filter the owning plan does not state, and relies only on the api-docs' 'Supported fields'.
findings.fix: P3.1 adds '<entity>Pk (EQUALS, IN)' to the Request/Filters line of API-FIN-005, API-FIN-009, API-FIN-012 and API-FIN-015, and to the fiscal-year search once it is numbered. This matches the as-built api-docs that ADR-FIN-065 cites.

findings.problem: The test plan says the SCR-FIN-013 deactivate confirmation has no stated text, so none is asserted. The ui-ux-spec does state ar/en confirmation copy for change-account and deactivate: REQ-FIN-058's guarantee, plus REQ-FIN-057's consequence for deactivate.
findings.fix: At its next run, test-gen asserts the spec's confirmation strings in TC-FIN-134 (change account) and TC-FIN-135 (deactivate), and removes the 'no stated text' sentence from the header.

findings.artifact: factory: gov.py state / gov.py render (platform finding)
findings.problem: gov.py state appends a 'carried from baseline v1' tail to files the delta restates in full. current-flow-diagram now ends with two contradictory RESULT lines ('reconciled 13 · reworked 3' and the carried 'reconciled 12 · reworked 0'). current-registry-srs and current-srs carry stale v1 tails (e.g. '16 rules … 0 ADRs'). Separately, the rendered brief's §2 artifact table has empty rows. Fold and render tools caused both; neither is an authoring error in this pass.
findings.fix: Record as an OPEN platform finding owned by the factory. gov.py state must not carry baseline text past the last marker when the delta file has no id-bearing tail, or it must treat a full restatement as replacing the whole file. gov.py render must fill §2 from the stage's artifact list. Once fixed, re-run state for FIN v2 and the stale tails disappear.
